title: EOG Resources (EOG) and Enterprise Products Partners (EPD) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Inflation, crypto, and energy balance sheets.
coverage_note: Read blocks 0-248 and all 32 image labels. Covers medical/economic assumptions, policy plumbing, gold, BTC/ETH, EOG/EPD and health insurers. Personal anecdote and incidental company descriptions excluded.

evidence.title: Severe outcomes after vaccination
evidence.finding: Among 1,228,664 vaccinated adults, 189 had severe outcomes and 36 died; older age, immunosuppression and other conditions raised risk. All severe cases had at least one risk factor. Findings do not generalize automatically to future variants.
